explication: Termux:X11 is an Android X server companion for Termux. The documented path is to launch the server from a Termux shell, start an X11 client with the matching display, and view its output in the Android app; users can interact through touch, keyboard, and configurable extra keys. The graph includes the app’s UI, input, and native rendering/server layers, plus documented preferences and multi-window behavior. Source excerpts are partial, so some native and runtime connections are intentionally not asserted.
